title: Safe Pruning for Detection and Segmentation
analysis: Both policies retained 36 channels across three branches. Uniform allocation produced aggregate RMSE 3.688635 and small-slice RMSE 5.187524; protecting the high-resolution branch produced 2.925958 and 2.448860, respectively. The per-slice table—not the aggregate alone—determines whether the risk trade is acceptable.
conclusion: Safe pruning treats the worst critical slice as a first-class constraint rather than trusting an aggregate metric.
